study: Physical-coordinate verification for radiomics software integration
specification_role: Held-out fault definitions prepared before final evaluation
evaluation_status_at_definition: Not executed or inspected by the specification author
mutation_scope: Owned integration adapters only; no modification of third-party libraries
development_faults_excluded: replace both image and mask spacing by unit spacing
double normalisation or biased scaling of feature outputs
independence_scope: New mutation mechanisms and held-out phantom seeds. Mathematical properties and portions of the diagnostic machinery overlap development; this is not external independent validation.

api.data_semantics: Decoded physical intensities, represented as float64 inside the adapter
api.writer_contract: stored=(data-intercept)/slope; header calibration is recorded and normally decoded by the reader
api.return_contract: Mutated deep copy with the same payload keys; caller input is not altered
api.inapplicable_mutation: FaultNotApplicable with reason; retain the attempted case and do not redraw its seed

fixture_requirements.geometry: Nonzero origin, anisotropic positive spacing and nonsymmetric oblique orthogonal direction; no shear
fixture_requirements.array: Three-dimensional, asymmetric physical-intensity field with at least two samples per axis
fixture_requirements.mask: Selected nonzero label exists; at least one trailing x plane is empty; asymmetric ROI includes neighbouring x voxels
fixture_requirements.intensity: Finite values within int16 range, including nonintegral quarter-unit values
fixture_requirements.scope_note: These activation requirements are fixed before held-out outcomes. They are engineering coverage choices, not clinical population sampling. Any unmet requirement must be reported.

evaluation_units.base_fault_combinations_note: 64 seeds times 8 fault families at one primary representation; additional representation variants remain dependent repeated cases
evaluation_units.controls: Unmodified frames and admissible transformed frames from the root evaluation protocol; no hidden control injector is included here
evaluation_units.no_posthoc_exclusion: Retain faults with little or no feature drift. Do not condition performance on whether a scalar output changed.
evaluation_units.no_universal_rates: Report by fault family and base phantom; do not interpret all transformed arrays or feature values as independent subjects.

faults.mechanism: A slice-list reader reverses only the image stack without applying the corresponding physical transform or changing the mask
faults.activation: At least two z slices and an intensity field not invariant under that reversal
faults.required_diagnostic: Physical-intensity correspondence violation; first divergent stage is the owned slice-order adapter
faults.feature_expectation: No universal magnitude prediction; selected ROI statistics or textures may change while some shape quantities remain unchanged

faults.mechanism: A shared buffer is read with Fortran indexing although it was flattened in C order
faults.operation: For both data and mask, ravel(order='C').reshape(original_shape,order='F'); affine unchanged
faults.activation: The paired reinterpretation changes at least one input array
changed: mapping from voxel indices to physical image samples
spatial arrangement of ROI and texture
faults.required_diagnostic: Physical correspondence violation despite retained paired first-order intensity distribution
faults.feature_expectation: First-order distribution and voxel-count volume can survive; spatial features need not. No scalar change is required for a true representation violation.

faults.mechanism: An ROI voxel index is shifted by one when converting an inclusive array index to a destination buffer
faults.operation: mask'[1:,:,:]=mask[:-1,:,:], with a zero first plane; data and affine unchanged
faults.activation: One empty trailing x plane prevents ROI truncation
changed: selection of image intensities by the ROI
faults.required_diagnostic: ROI correspondence violation with exactly one x-index displacement of retained labelled samples
faults.feature_expectation: Shape volume is preserved. The masked intensity distribution may or may not change; record it rather than assuming a minimum effect.

faults.mechanism: A binary ROI is averaged at half a voxel using a linear operation and then cast to integer labels by truncation
faults.operation: Average selected-label support with its previous-x neighbour, truncate to uint8 and restore the selected label; preserve other labels
faults.activation: A finite nonempty selected ROI; neighbouring x voxels are part of the planned fixtures
faults.required_diagnostic: ROI-support violation; report an empty or unextractable result if one occurs rather than dropping the case
faults.feature_expectation: The operation retains the intersection with the shifted ROI. Retained voxel count can only decrease; no numerical feature error size is assumed.

faults.mechanism: A row-major direction matrix is treated as column-major at an interface boundary
faults.activation: Positive spacing, orthogonal direction and D different from D.T
faults.required_diagnostic: Physical-coordinate witness violation even if all scalar measurements remain unchanged
faults.feature_expectation: Physically rotation-invariant scalar measurements may all survive. That is an intended blind spot of feature-only checking, not a reason to exclude the fault.

faults.mechanism: The origin of the centre of the first voxel is interpreted as the outer corner of that voxel
changed: physical point locations by a common half-voxel offset
faults.required_diagnostic: Physical-coordinate witness violation; for orthogonal axes the displacement magnitude is 0.5*sqrt(sx^2+sy^2+sz^2)
faults.feature_expectation: Translation-invariant scalar outputs are expected to remain unchanged, demonstrating that scalar agreement cannot prove physical identity

faults.mechanism: The decoder adds the calibration intercept before applying the slope
faults.operation: stored=(data-b)/a; data'=(stored+b)*a; keep slope a and intercept b for the later correct writer
faults.activation: Finite nonzero slope a, a!=1, and nonzero intercept b
changed: physical intensities by the constant b*(a-1)
preserved: intensity ranks and pairwise differences in exact arithmetic
faults.required_diagnostic: Intensity-calibration correspondence violation; nonzero mean anchor follows the same additive error
faults.feature_expectation: For the frozen a=2,b=-8 setting, the physical intensity and ROI-mean offsets are -8 before file-rounding effects; variance can remain unchanged

faults.mechanism: Decoded floating-point intensities are passed through an int16 temporary buffer before re-encoding
faults.operation: data'=data.astype(int16).astype(float64), truncating toward zero; metadata unchanged
faults.activation: All data fit int16 and at least one intensity is nonintegral, isolating truncation from overflow
changed: physical intensity values with a nonzero fractional part
faults.required_diagnostic: Intensity correspondence violation; pre-writer absolute error is less than one intensity unit per changed voxel
faults.feature_expectation: Some texture values may be unchanged if discretised bins remain unchanged; no minimum downstream feature drift is required

representative_contrast_fixed_before_out.purpose: Show that operational error size and downstream scalar drift are different properties; these are not validated clinical severity categories
required_report: maximum physical point displacement in mm where a matching source-index map is defined
maximum absolute decoded intensity discrepancy on corresponding source samples
ROI support agreement after mapping to the declared common physical frame
absolute volume error and volume ratio where reference volume is nonzero
per-feature absolute error plus error divided by max(1,abs(reference)) in stated feature units
physical-witness decision, nominal geometry decision and feature-only decision
representative_contrast_fixed_before_out.magnitude_note: Report observed displacement and intensity differences; do not force 'large' or 'small' feature effects to fit these planned examples. Do not calculate a geometric displacement by naively subtracting arrays from incompatible frames.

freeze_policy.contents: UTC timestamp and SHA256 of this specification and software/faultinjectors.py
freeze_policy.amendments: Any later change requires a separately recorded reason, hashes and identification of outcomes already inspected; never silently rewrite the frozen definitions
